title: Homemade Vanilla Pod Cream Soda
summary: A bubbly, vanilla-scented drink made from a chilled homemade vanilla syrup topped with sparkling water and ice.

steps.title: Heat
steps.text: Put 240 ml water and 200 g sugar in a small pan, scrape in the seeds from 1 vanilla pod and add the pod. Bring to a simmer, stirring until the sugar dissolves.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Take off the heat and leave to infuse until cool, about 1 h.

steps.title: Strain
steps.text: Strain the syrup into a jar (or leave the pod in for stronger flavour) and chill.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Fill each of 8 tall glasses with 2 ice cubes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Add 3–4 tbsp chilled syrup to each glass and top with about 240 ml chilled sparkling water, pouring slowly down the side to keep the fizz; stir once gently and serve.

tips: Make the vanilla syrup ahead and keep it chilled for up to two weeks.
Pour the sparkling water down the side of the glass, not down the middle, to preserve the fizz.
storage: The vanilla syrup keeps chilled for two weeks; assemble drinks fresh to order to keep the fizz. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
